name: implant
description: Use VS Code language services, extension commands, and structural search directly from Copilot Chat and VS Code agents.

implant.timeoutMs.description: Hard execution timeout per script, in milliseconds. 0 disables the timeout — the user cancels long-running scripts through the notification that appears after 10 seconds. Set to a positive number to also enforce an automatic upper bound.

chatParticipants.name: implant
chatParticipants.description: Ask in English, get answers or edits by running vscode.* calls in the extension host.

languageModelTools.name: implant_run_vscode_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute JavaScript in the VS Code extension host with access to the vscode API, language services, and installed extensions. Use for semantic code queries and editor operations. This tool can modify files or run arbitrary extension-host code; inspect the requested action carefully.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a JavaScript snippet in VS Code with the user's approval.

code.description: JavaScript source executed as the body of an async function. The vscode and astGrep globals are available.

timeoutMs.description: Optional per-call hard timeout in milliseconds; overrides implant.timeoutMs. 0 disables the timeout.
